note: Files: runs/theory-rows/s3k/r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl (base, cue) and runs/theory-rows/s3k/r4/modal_t2-01/t2/T2.jsonl (RL, plain), fetched from S3 if missing; 500 rows each, one sample per problem, joined by unique_id. Rows kept if cap_hit is False and text is a non-empty string; exposure and events are pooled over each model's kept rows. Main number: unpaired pooling (each model uses all its own kept rows, as the recipe says). alt_measured: paired reading, using only problems where both the T1 and the T2 row are kept. Result positions: end of every '=\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?' match, plus one past the brace-balanced closing '}' of every '\boxed{' occurrence, nested ones included (braces counted literally, '\{' not treated specially). Unclosed boxes are skipped. d(i)=i before the first result (origin 0); d=0 at a result position. Events are binned by d at the match start. Undefined cases: the recipe says base rate 0 in B1 or B4 counts as refuted, and the script prints refuted_without_number. It also treats zero base exposure in those bins, zero RL exposure in B1, or R_1 = 0 as undefined, and handles them the same way; the recipe does not cover those cases. Bootstrap over problems (tuples of the T1/T2 per-row bin counts); a resample where the statistic is undefined counts as +inf, which could widen the upper end of the interval. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is false. example_row text is cut to 300 characters.

Same files, join, filters, result positions, d(i) on the full comma-deleted text, bins and event regex as p1 (same code, HALF=True). Exposure counts integer indices i < len(text)/2, implemented as i < ceil(len/2), so an odd length includes the middle index (len-1)/2. Events count only if their start s < len/2, using the same bound. Undefined, printed as refuted_without_number: T1 rate 0 in B1 or B4, or T2 exposure 0 in B4 (both from the recipe). Zero T1 exposure in B1/B4, zero T2 exposure in B1 and R_1 = 0 are also treated as undefined; those are my additions. Main number: unpaired pooling. alt_measured: paired problems only (both rows kept). B4 needs d >= 1500 inside the first half, so only long answers with long result-free stretches add exposure there. B4 counts may be small, which makes the ratio and its bootstrap interval noisy, and resamples where it is undefined (counted as +inf) are possible. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is false.
